note: Starts the queue leaves out that reports/library_functions.json does not cover. library: a Microsoft library function (C runtime, XAPILIB) found byte for byte in another game's build with the same SDK, which reports/library_functions.json missed. bink: RAD Bink, third-party code linked into the Xbox game's own section (called from the BINK section, padded with 0x90 where the game's compiler pads with 0xCC). nonstart: not the start of a function (an exception-handling funclet that reads its parent's frame, a label inside another function, a misaligned decode, or a shared tail). protection (PC only): the copy protection replaced part of the function with a jump of its own, so the accepted file does not hold the game's code there (docs/GAME_VERSIONS.md); the ones that jump through a pointer in the protection's own section are found by the portal itself and are not listed. From the examiner's A1 pass over default.xbe; a matched function is never left out.
